name: redis-agent-memory-mcp
description: Shared Redis Agent Memory bridge for Claude Code and Codex

scripts.capture:install: npm run build && node dist/src/capture-cli.js install
scripts.capture:install:claude-desktop: npm run build && node dist/src/capture-cli.js install --claude-desktop
scripts.capture:import:claude: npm run build && node dist/src/capture-cli.js import-claude
scripts.capture:import:chatgpt: npm run build && node dist/src/capture-cli.js import-chatgpt
scripts.capture:watch-imports: npm run build && node dist/src/capture-cli.js watch-imports
scripts.mcpb:test: npm run mcpb:validate && npm run mcpb:build && node scripts/smoke-mcpb.mjs
scripts.plugin:test: node scripts/build-chatgpt-runtime.mjs --check && npm run plugin:validate && npm run plugin:build && node scripts/build-chatgpt-plugin.mjs --remote-url https://memory.example.test/mcp --output build/redis-agent-memory-chatgpt-remote-test.zip && node scripts/smoke-chatgpt-plugin.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/**/*.test.js && node scripts/smoke-prompt-recall.mjs && node scripts/smoke-memory-check.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:handoff: npm run mcpb:build && npm run plugin:build && node --test integration/claude-chatgpt.test.mjs
scripts.claude-plugin:test: npm run claude-plugin:validate && node scripts/build-claude-plugin.mjs --check && npm run build && node --test dist/test/memory-setup.test.js && node scripts/smoke-claude-plugin.mjs
scripts.capture:share-settings: npm run build && node dist/src/capture-cli.js share-settings
